project.name: Auth Watch
project.author: MTDI Studio example
project.description: A [[log probe]] counts [[failed]] and [[accepted]] authentications per window on a Linux host. Environmental Intelligence learns the machine's normal rhythm, so a burst of failures stands out against its own history instead of a fixed threshold.

rules.text: Failed authentications rose far beyond this host's learned rhythm without matching successful logins, the pattern of password guessing. A misconfigured client retrying stale credentials looks the same; check the source addresses in the log.
Both failed and accepted logins rose. A person mistyping then succeeding explains it; so would a guess that eventually worked. Worth confirming who logged in.

aether.purpose: Shows MTDI in cybersecurity: the same Environmental Intelligence that learns a room's magnetic field learns a server's normal login rhythm.
